tools.name: add_observations
tools.description:
Add new observations (timestamped facts) to existing entities.

Each observation has 'entityName' and 'contents': a list where each entry is
either a plain string or an object {text, validFrom?, validTo?, source?,
supersedes?}. validFrom is when the fact became true in the world (e.g. the
meeting date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601) and defaults to write time; recordedAt
is always set to write time. 'supersedes' names the exact text of an active
fact on the same entity to close (its validTo becomes the new fact's
validFrom) - it errors if the target is missing or already superseded.
Deduplicates by text. Returns error if entity doesn't exist.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description:
Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph.

Each entity should have 'name', 'entityType', and 'observations' fields.
Observation entries may be plain strings or fact objects {text, validFrom,
validTo, recordedAt, source}; they are stored as given (use add_observations
for write-time temporal defaults). Deduplicates by entity name - existing
entities are skipped. New entities receive 'createdAt' and 'lastUpdated'
ISO 8601 UTC timestamps.

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description:
Create multiple new relations between entities.

Each relation should have 'from', 'to', and 'relationType' fields.
Deduplicates by the (from, to, relationType) tuple.
New relations receive 'createdAt' and 'lastUpdated' ISO 8601 UTC timestamps.

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description:
Delete entities and their associated relations from the knowledge graph.

Takes a list of entity names to delete. Relations involving deleted entities
are also removed (cascade delete).

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description:
Delete specific observations from entities.

Each deletion should have 'entityName' and 'observations' (list of exact
fact texts to remove). Removes facts entirely regardless of temporal state;
to close a fact while keeping history, supersede it via add_observations
instead. Silently ignores missing entities or observations.

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description:
Delete specific relations from the knowledge graph.

Each relation should have 'from', 'to', and 'relationType' fields.
All three fields must match for deletion.

tools.name: merge_entities
tools.description:
Merge the source entity into the target entity.

The source is removed; the target absorbs the source's observations
(unioned, target order preserved) and relations (re-pointed, self-loops
dropped, duplicates collapsed keeping the earliest createdAt). Target's
entityType is kept; if source's entityType differed it is returned as
'discardedType' in the response. createdAt becomes the earliest non-null
of the two. Errors if either entity is missing or source == target.

tools.name: normalize_entity_types
tools.description:
Normalize all entity types in the knowledge graph using configured aliases.

Applies type alias mappings and Title Case normalization to all existing entities.
Returns a summary of changes made. Read-only tokens are rejected.

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description:
Open specific nodes by name from the knowledge graph.

Returns the requested entities (observations as fact objects, with
'createdAt'/'lastUpdated' timestamps) and any relations where at least one
endpoint is in the requested set.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description:
Read the entire knowledge graph.

Returns all entities and relations for the authenticated user.
Entities include 'createdAt' and 'lastUpdated' timestamps (null for legacy
data); observations are fact objects {text, validFrom?, validTo?,
recordedAt?, source?}.

tools.name: rename_entity
tools.description:
Rename an entity in the knowledge graph.

Updates the entity's name and rewrites every relation that references it
(both 'from' and 'to' endpoints). Errors if the source entity is not found,
if an entity with 'new_name' already exists (use merge_entities to combine
them), or if name == new_name. Bumps lastUpdated on the entity and on every
touched relation. Returns {renamed: {from, to}, relationsUpdated: N}.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description:
Search observations as timestamped facts with temporal filters.

All parameters are optional and combine as AND filters:
- query: case-insensitive substring matched against fact text
- entityName: exact entity filter
- asOf: return facts valid at that instant (validFrom <= asOf < validTo);
  facts without validFrom count as always valid
- since/until: window on validFrom; facts without validFrom are excluded
- includeSuperseded: include facts whose validity ended (default false;
  implied by asOf)
- order: 'desc' (default, newest validFrom first) or 'asc' (history order);
  facts without validFrom sort last
- limit: max facts returned (default 20)
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601; resolve relative times before calling.
Returns {facts: [{entityName, text, validFrom, validTo, recordedAt,
source}], total} where total counts matches before the limit.

asOf.description: facts valid at this instant (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601)

includeSuperseded.description: include facts whose validity ended (default false)

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description:
Search for nodes in the knowledge graph.

Performs case-insensitive search across entity names, types, and observation
text. Returns matching entities (observations as fact objects) and any
relations where at least one endpoint matches. For fact-level temporal
queries (as-of, since/until, history) use search_facts instead.
